articles.summary: Explore RedBrick AI's Q3 2024 updates including the new SAM2-powered Mask Propagation Tool, Document Viewer for radiological reports, Read-only Labels, Study Selector for better DICOM organization, Label Groups, Customizable Hotkeys, and support for new formats like MHD, MHA, and DCE MRI.
